_about: Extra choices on the Create page's Advanced tab. Each choice adds words to the prompt and to what the model avoids; the first value of each is the default and adds nothing. They cost no extra time. Change the words here; the page reads this file each time.

values.label: Still
values.negative: camera shake, camera movement, zoom, pan

values.label: Turn around
values.prompt: camera slowly orbits around the subject, 360 turnaround

values.label: Zoom in
values.prompt: slow push in, camera slowly moves closer

values.label: Gentle
values.prompt: subtle gentle motion, calm, idle animation
values.negative: fast motion, sudden movement, motion blur

values.label: From the front
values.prompt: front lighting, evenly lit, bright, full color

values.label: Dramatic
values.prompt: dramatic cinematic lighting, strong shadows, rim light

values.label: Seamless loop
values.prompt: seamless loop, looping animation, ends where it starts
